context: A screenshot of ghent-live, a 3D map of the historic centre of Ghent (Belgium), rendered in a web browser and seen from straight above with north up. A red ring marks the Belfry in the middle of the view. This view shows the ground layer only: land, water and the streets.

checks.name: river
checks.instructions: A river runs through the city: a continuous, winding band of water crosses the map.

checks.name: medieval_streets
checks.instructions: The streets form an irregular, medieval pattern of narrow, curving streets of varying width, not a grid.

checks.name: no_square_grid
checks.instructions: No plain square grid is visible: there are no evenly spaced, straight grid lines across the ground.
